title: Red Embroidered Bodice by the Sea
prompt: An original young woman with dark brown hair in a loose side braid, with strands blowing across her face, wears a red embroidered high-necked bodice over a white gathered blouse with puff sleeves. Red ribbon ties hang from her shoulders, and gold drop earrings catch the light. She stands on a windswept shoreline under an overcast sky. Her expression is steady and serious. Soft, muted daylight, a palette of crimson, cream, and sandy gold. Timeless and windswept, in the style of a film photograph.
workingNotes:
- The red embroidery against the cream blouse is the defining contrast.
- Keep the overcast sky to maintain the muted palette.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the overcast sky for a muted palette.
